result.stdout:
PeasyPilot CLI - Unified Test Runner
Usage:
  peasypilot [options]
  peasypilot history

Options:
  -f, --filter <name>         Filter tests by name (case insensitive)
  -c, --changed-files <f1,f2> Run impact analysis for comma-separated changed files
  -fmt, --format <format>     Output format: console, json, junit
  -o, --output <path>         File path to save JSON or JUnit report
  -h, --help                  Show help information
